method: API evaluator 1.0: three caption-blind observers each received only the image inside the request; a coder, run 2 times, received only the contract and their answers split into numbered units and cited a unit for each finding; code verified every citation and computed the verdict, which passes only when every coding passes (scripts/lib/adjudication.mjs). AI review is not clinical approval.

observers.label: Caption-blind observer 1 (Claude)

answers.1: The head and upper neck of a person, drawn from behind and slightly to the side, so you see the back of the head, one cheek and the tip of the nose as the face turns away to the right.
answers.2: The hair is brown and swept up; over the upper back of the head there is a lighter, close-cropped or shaved-looking patch drawn with fine short strokes. A wide white cloth or gauze strip is wrapped all the way around the head, sitting just below the level of the crown and passing over the ear area; it is knotted in a small bow near the left edge of the picture, at the back/side of the head, with two short loops and tails hanging down. A square white dressing pad with rounded corners and a textured, woven-looking surface lies over the ear region on the near side, held down by the wrap. No blood, bruising, rash or broken skin is drawn; the skin looks plain and even.
answers.3: No text, numbers, arrows, labels or symbols anywhere in the picture. The only line details are the shading of the hair, the cloth and the pad's woven texture.
answers.4: Someone might read it as a serious head wound or post-surgery bandage over the ear, rather than a simple dressing being held in place.
